Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Booth data capture: badge scan + consent wording

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for sponsoring the expo hall — excited to have Redwood as a Gold sponsor. Quick ask from our side: the event team needs the exact payload and consent language we'll display at the badge-scanner kiosk so we can clear it with legal and the venue.

Two specifics:
- Is Redwood ok with us passing company and job title (from the badge) to HubSpot and also sending a copy to your SFDC ingest?
- For EU attendees we need explicit opt-in language and a checkbox copy. Can you share the phrasing you'd prefer?

Also, one of our sponsors (Acme) wants to opt into lead-share — if that's possible please indicate how you want that represented in the feed (field name, boolean, partner id).

I can connect you to LeadSync (the scanner vendor) if helpful.

Cheers,
James
GlobalConf — Exhibit Ops

Attachments: none

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Thanks James — looping in Ops (Marcus), Field Marketing (Lauren) and Privacy (Stephanie).

High-level plan:
- Marcus: confirm the scanner CSV schema, HTTPS webhook payload, and whether LeadSync can push to HubSpot directly or we pull. We also need a stable dedupe key for SFDC. See Marcus's mapping request below.
- Lauren: final copy for the kiosk opt-in (EU/UK phrasing + an accessible short blur). We prefer the attendee to check a single box that covers marketing contact and sponsor share options separately.
- Stephanie: confirm the minimum GDPR-compliant wording and whether we need an extra checkbox for partner opt-in (Acme).

Please attach the mapping doc and any vendor guide. We'll aim to have the HubSpot form and SFDC mapping ready for a dry run on May 18.

Thanks all — Hannah
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference

Attachment: event-playbook link (see related_links)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: LeadSync Ops <ops@leadsync.com>, James Taylor <james.taylor@globalconf.org>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Booth data capture: badge scan + consent wording

Hi team — quick technical notes after talking with LeadSync. Attaching the "lead-fields-mapping.xlsx" and a small CSV spec for SFDC dedupe. Summary below:

- Primary keys: email (if present), otherwise badge_id + company_normalized as fallback. We will populate SFDC External ID with badge_id when email is missing.
- Fields available from scanner: full_name, email, company, title, phone, badge_id, scan_timestamp, country, consent_flags (string of flags).
- HubSpot: LeadSync can POST to a HubSpot form endpoint; payload must include hubspot_form_id and portal_id. We will map company->company, title->jobtitle, consent_flags->properties.custom_consent (boolean array or CSV). See mapping sheet.
- Partner opt-in: add partner_share:true/false and partner_id (e.g., ACME-001) in payload. We will map partner_share to HubSpot property "partner_share" and to SFDC boolean field "Partner_Lead__c".
- Sync cadence: real-time (webhook) preferred; fallback sFTP drop every hour if vendor connectivity is flaky.

Action items for me: verify webhook certificate pin with LeadSync, and add a lightweight transform lambda to normalize company before ingestion.

Attachments: leadsync-setup-guide.pdf, sfdc-dedupe-key-spec.csv, lead-fields-mapping.xlsx

--

Hey — putting suggested kiosk copy here and flagging a couple UX items. Attached: gdpr-optin-copy.txt.

Kiosk headline (short): "Get product updates and partner offers"
Body (short): "By tapping your badge you agree Redwood Inference may contact you about products and share your business contact details with our event partners for legitimate interest and marketing purposes. You can opt out at any time."
Opt-in checklist (two toggles on the kiosk UI):
- "I agree to be contacted by Redwood about product updates and events." (required for marketing outreach)
- "I consent to my contact details being shared with event partners (e.g., Acme) for relevant offers." (optional)

UX notes:
- Make the partner toggle unchecked by default for EU visitors.
- Display a one-line link to our privacy page and a short expansion that shows retention period (12 months for event leads).

Stephanie — need your quick sign-off on this phrasing and whether we need a separate checkbox text for the venue or third-party data processors.

Thanks — Lauren
Sr. Field Marketing Manager

Thanks — reviewed the proposed language and mapping. A few compliance notes:

- For EU attendees we must present consent with an active opt-in control; partner sharing must be opt-in (unchecked by default). Your suggested two-toggle approach is fine.
- Retention: 12 months for event-only leads unless the lead opts in to marketing (24 months). Add retention_period property to the payload.
- Data minimization: do not capture phone unless the attendee actively provides it (scanner may pull phone from badge if attendees prefilled; make this explicit in the kiosk UX).
- Audit trail: require LeadSync to include "consent_source": "kiosk_v1" and a timestamp in every record. We will store the raw consent_flags string in a secure ledger for audits.

I attached the recommended phrasing file (gdpr-optin-copy.txt). We should also include a short privacy snippet on the printed badge receipt email.

Approved pending small edits to retention and consent_source.
